row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (no public pricing; lessonly.com/pricing redirects to a demo request)
row.evidence: Seismic's developer portal says "Seismic Platform SCIM APIs can be used to manage both Seismic Content and Seismic Learning users", and lessonly.com/pricing redirects to a Lessonly by Seismic demo request with no public prices.
row.notes: Quote-only: Lessonly is now sold as Seismic Learning ('Lessonly by Seismic'); lessonly.com/pricing redirects to a demo-request form and seismic.com/pricing is 404. Since the FY24 Winter release, upgraded tenants manage Learning users as Seismic Platform users through Seismic's SCIM 2.0 API (https://api.seismic.com/scim/v2, JWT bearer with seismic.user.manage scope): Users and Groups CRUD, PATCH replace only, active=false to deactivate, DELETE is permanent; Learning roles Admin/Creator/Manager/Learner/custom. The Okta OIN 'Seismic Learning' app supports SAML and SCIM create/update/deactivate. Entra gallery app (Lessonly) is SSO with JIT. The legacy Lessonly REST API (api.lessonly.com, Basic auth with API key) is losing user/group write support in favour of the Seismic Public API. No plan gate for SCIM is published.

auth.token_source: Seismic OAuth JWT access token with seismic.user.manage scope

endpoints.notes: ResourceTypes from the reference navigation ('Get resource types').

operations.notes: PATCH supports only the replace op; reactivation by setting active back to true is implied, not explicit.

deprovision.notes: Inactive users are locked and cannot log in; DELETE is permanent. For joint Content+Learning users, Seismic says to remove the Learning role by PATCH instead.

filtering.notes: Operators eq, ne, co, gt, ge, lt, le with and/or; no sorting.

custom.how: Tenant-specific custom properties via urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:extension:seismic:2.0:User (definitions from GET /scim/v2/Schemas); extended properties include ssoId, seismicRoles, location, managerName, biography

roles.how: roles attribute: Learning roles Admin, Creator, Manager, Learner or custom; Content roles Premium, Business, Partner (case sensitive). roles override userType.

rate_limits.text: 429 Too Many Requests when a rate-limit policy is hit; SCIM falls in the default tier of 600 calls per 60 seconds.

limitations.text: PATCH supports only the replace operation.
Applies to tenants upgraded to Seismic Platform user management.

scim.notes: Paths seen: POST/GET /scim/v2/Users, PUT/PATCH/DELETE /scim/v2/Users/{userId}, POST /scim/v2/Groups, POST /scim/v2/Users/{userId}/Groups/{groupId}, GET /scim/v2/ServiceProviderConfig, GET /scim/v2/Schemas.

webhooks_user_events.notes: Seismic platform event names from the developer-portal navigation.

limitations.text: Seismic is limiting Lessonly Public API write endpoints for users and groups for upgraded tenants; use the Seismic Public API instead.
API key access may need to be activated on request.

user_api.notes: Lessonly legacy API paths are relative to https://api.lessonly.com. The audit endpoint is on the Seismic API (api.seismic.com).

okta.notes: OIN 'Seismic Learning' app (internal name lessonly) marks SAML, SCIM, Create, Update, Deactivate (read from page markup); builder not stated.

entra.notes: Gallery tutorial covers SP-initiated SSO with JIT; no provisioning tutorial (lessonly-provisioning-tutorial 404).

fallbacks.notes: JIT is stated on Microsoft's Entra tutorial.
